profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Pinterest
profile.summary:
Welcome to my LinkedIn page! I am a future software developer. I am currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Computer Science at Northeastern University, Seattle. I enjoy problem solving. I value exploring faster and efficient solutions. I have a mechanical engineering (mechatronics) background. It has provided me with an insight about the significance of finding optimized solutions, as well as the coding experiences.

Cloud computing has become a critical component in the world. It constructs an efficient system for businesses and has a deep impact on my daily life. This is where I want to kick off my journey as a SDE. I want to benefit the world with real data and examples. 

Currently I am looking for a SDE fall internship/co-op. Thank you!

projects.title: Scalable Distributed Ski Resort Registry System
projects.description:
Developed a ski resort registry system that can handle 200K lift ride requests and properly map the
data to Redis in a timely and memory efficient manner by vertically and horizontally scaling clients
and servers and by utilizing the RabbitMQ message broker. Increased the throughput by 39.6% by tuning the system.

projects.title: "Amgi" App Development
projects.description: Web based flashcard application developed using MERN stack. Mainly worked on the backend component. Successfully deployed the project.
